# mdbindery

> Build EPUB 3 ebooks or paginated PDFs from Markdown chapters and mdBook projects. Shared preparation handles links, citations, images, Mermaid, math and tables. EPUB uses EPUBCheck, Ace and per-file word counts; PDF checks resources, internal links and extracted text. Review reports and layout before publishing.

- Released version: `0.2.0`. PDF export requires the optional `pdf` extra.
- License: MIT
- Author: Taras Baranyuk
- Repository: https://github.com/sagol/mdbindery
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/mdbindery/
- Site: https://sagol.github.io/mdbindery/
- Full LLM reference: https://sagol.github.io/mdbindery/llms-full.txt
- Agent manifest: https://sagol.github.io/mdbindery/agents.json

## Quick commands

Standalone installers need Bash, curl, tar, and checksum utilities on Linux/macOS, or PowerShell on Windows. No preinstalled Python, Java, or Node.js is needed.

```bash
# Install (Linux / macOS — no preinstalled Python, Java, or Node.js; no root required)
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sagol/mdbindery/main/install/install.sh | bash

# Install (Windows PowerShell)
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sagol/mdbindery/main/install/install.ps1 | iex

# Install via uv / pipx / Homebrew
uv tool install mdbindery && mdbindery install-tools
pipx install mdbindery && mdbindery install-tools
brew install sagol/tap/mdbindery && mdbindery install-tools

# Verify toolchain (pandoc, epubcheck, java, node, mermaid, ace, python)
mdbindery doctor

# Dry-run static + pandoc check on local folder or remote GitHub URL
mdbindery check https://github.com/OWNER/REPO
mdbindery check . --json /tmp/mdb-check.json --report /tmp/mdb-check.md -q
mdbindery check . --build

# Generate starter mdbindery.yaml from inferred structure
mdbindery init

# Build EPUB 3 and run configured validation gates
mdbindery build path/to/your-book

# PDF: install the extra in your Python environment
python -m pip install 'mdbindery[pdf]>=0.2.0'
mdbindery install-tools
mdbindery build path/to/your-book --format pdf

# Render EPUB phone-size (412x915 CSS px, 2x scale) PNG screenshots
mdbindery preview dist/writing-a-book-in-markdown.epub shots
```

## Coding-agent skills (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, Gemini CLI)

- [Run mdbindery skill (SKILL.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sagol/mdbindery/main/skills/mdbindery/SKILL.md): Install, run `doctor`, `check`, `init`, `build`, `preview`, parse JSON reports (`dist/reports/build.json`), and interpret gates and exit codes.
- [Prepare repository skill (SKILL.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sagol/mdbindery/main/skills/mdbindery-prepare-repo/SKILL.md): Restructure Markdown repository or mdBook to resolve `MB001`–`MB904` findings while keeping GitHub rendering intact.

## Documentation

- [Full LLM reference (llms-full.txt)](https://sagol.github.io/mdbindery/llms-full.txt): Complete single-file reference with CLI flags, exit codes, `mdbindery.yaml` schema, all 59 MB check codes and format-specific gates.
- [Tutorial](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sagol/mdbindery/main/docs/tutorial.md): Walkthrough for building and checking an EPUB 3 ebook from Markdown.
- [Book structure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sagol/mdbindery/main/docs/book-structure.md): Headings, relative links, anchors, `[1]` citations, footnotes, images, covers, tables, Mermaid charts.
- [Configuration reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sagol/mdbindery/main/docs/configuration.md): Every `mdbindery.yaml` key (`metadata`, `files`, `cover`, `options`).
- [Checks and diagnostic codes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sagol/mdbindery/main/docs/checking.md): `mdbindery check`, JSON report format, and every `MB001`–`MB904` diagnostic code with fix instructions.
- [Builds and validation gates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sagol/mdbindery/main/docs/building.md): Build pipeline, outputs (`dist/<slug>.epub`, `dist/reports/build.json`, `dist/reports/epubcheck.json`, `dist/reports/ace/report.json`), reproducibility conditions, and validation gates.
- [PDF export](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sagol/mdbindery/main/docs/pdf.md): PDF installation, A4/Letter settings, margins, fonts, text/resource checks and layout limits. Reports use `reports/pdf/`; EPUB remains default.
- [Installation guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sagol/mdbindery/main/docs/installation.md): Linux, macOS, Windows, offline/CI setups, GitHub Action (`uses: sagol/mdbindery@v0.2.0`).
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sagol/mdbindery/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): Common errors and remediation steps.
- [Architecture and design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sagol/mdbindery/main/docs/design.md): Internal pipeline, Lua filters (`book.lua`), CSS (`epub.css`), and gate mechanics.
